details.name: Tangtang
details.quote: Qingbo Stockade's Chief, Tangtang, reporting as promised! Now you can just hand Endfield over to me; I'll make it the toughest spot on Talos-II! Turn in a proposal? C'mon, since when does a chief do paperwork? We'll just figure it out together!
details.infection: Oripathy positive (infected), based on medical examination reports.
details.exp1d: Combat Technique: Speed Reloader Pair of hands for a pair of iron. The Supreme Chief's bullets are always right on target.
details.exp2d: Agility: Nimble Escapist She's skilled in escaping trouble. How did she get in trouble? You might need to ask her yourself.
details.hb1d: Nature: Water Affinity Tangtang is the river's daughter. She feels at home at watery places.
details.hb2d: Creative: Stockade Upgrader Tangtang's plans often shock the Stockaders. They have no idea where she gets her inspirations from.
